title: 1.4 The Light Microscope
description: Parts, functions, handling, and care of the light microscope

questions.question: Which part of the microscope do you look through to view the specimen?
questions.correctAnswer: Eyepiece or ocular lens

questions.question: Which part of the microscope holds the objective lenses and rotates to allow changing of magnification?
questions.correctAnswer: Revolving nosepiece

questions.question: What is the function of the objective lenses on a microscope?
options: To magnify the specimen at different powers
To focus light on the specimen
To hold the slide in place
questions.correctAnswer: To magnify the specimen at different powers

questions.question: Which part of the microscope connects the eyepiece to the nosepiece?
questions.correctAnswer: Body tube

questions.question: What is the function of the stage on a microscope?
options: To hold the glass slide containing the specimen
questions.correctAnswer: To hold the glass slide containing the specimen

questions.question: Which parts of the microscope are used to secure the glass slide in place on the stage?
questions.correctAnswer: Stage clips

questions.question: What is the function of the diaphragm on a microscope?
options: To control the amount of light passing through the specimen
questions.correctAnswer: To control the amount of light passing through the specimen

questions.question: Which part of the microscope is located below the stage and focuses light onto the specimen?
questions.correctAnswer: Condenser

questions.question: Which adjustment knob is used for initial focusing and moves the stage up and down quickly?
questions.correctAnswer: Coarse adjustment knob

questions.question: Which adjustment knob is used for precise focusing and bringing the image into sharp detail?
questions.correctAnswer: Fine adjustment knob

questions.question: Which part of the microscope is used to carry the instrument and supports the body tube?
questions.correctAnswer: Arm

questions.question: Which part of the microscope provides a sturdy, flat support for the entire instrument?
questions.correctAnswer: Base

questions.question: What is the function of the light source (or mirror) in a microscope?
options: To provide illumination so the specimen can be seen
questions.correctAnswer: To provide illumination so the specimen can be seen

questions.question: How should a microscope be properly carried?
options: By holding it with one hand on the stage
By holding the arm with one hand and supporting the base with the other hand
By carrying it with two hands on the base
questions.correctAnswer: By holding the arm with one hand and supporting the base with the other hand

questions.question: When starting to focus a slide on low power, where should the objective lens be positioned?
options: As far from the stage as possible
Close to the slide without touching it
questions.correctAnswer: Close to the slide without touching it

questions.question: When focusing a specimen, which objective lens should be used first?
questions.correctAnswer: Low power objective

questions.question: How do you calculate the total magnification of a microscope?
options: Add the eyepiece magnification to the objective magnification
Multiply the eyepiece magnification by the objective magnification
Divide the objective magnification by the eyepiece magnification
Subtract the objective magnification from the eyepiece magnification
questions.correctAnswer: Multiply the eyepiece magnification by the objective magnification

questions.question: If the eyepiece magnification is 10X and the objective lens magnification is 40X, what is the total magnification?
Why should the coarse adjustment knob not be used when focusing under high power?
options: It will not move the stage
It could break the slide or damage the objective lens
questions.correctAnswer: It could break the slide or damage the objective lens

questions.question: What should be used to clean the lenses of a microscope?
questions.correctAnswer: Lens paper

questions.question: When storing a microscope, which objective lens should be clicked into place over the stage?
questions.correctAnswer: The lowest power objective

questions.question: What should be done with the microscope cord before storing it?
options: Wrap it loosely around the microscope base
questions.correctAnswer: Wrap it loosely around the microscope base

questions.question: What is the function of the coarse adjustment knob?
options: To make fine, small adjustments to focus
To make large, rapid movements to bring the specimen into general focus
questions.correctAnswer: To make large, rapid movements to bring the specimen into general focus

questions.question: What happens to the field of view as you increase magnification?
options: The field of view becomes larger
The field of view becomes smaller
The field of view stays the same
questions.correctAnswer: The field of view becomes smaller

questions.question: Why should you always carry a microscope with two hands?
options: To distribute weight evenly and prevent dropping it
Because it is a school rule
To prevent dust from settling on it
questions.correctAnswer: To distribute weight evenly and prevent dropping it

questions.question: What is the function of the stage opening (aperture) on a microscope?
options: To allow light to pass through the stage and the specimen
questions.correctAnswer: To allow light to pass through the stage and the specimen

questions.question: What is the advantage of using a microscope with a built-in light source over one with a mirror?
options: It provides more consistent and controllable illumination
questions.correctAnswer: It provides more consistent and controllable illumination

questions.question: If the image you see through the microscope is blurry after using the coarse adjustment knob, what should you use next?
questions.correctAnswer: The fine adjustment knob

questions.question: How does the image appear when viewed through a compound light microscope compared to the actual specimen?
questions.correctAnswer: Inverted and reversed

questions.question: What should you do to the microscope after use before covering it?
options: Clean the stage and lenses with lens paper
questions.correctAnswer: Clean the stage and lenses with lens paper
